purpose: runtime identity contract for Qwen3.5-4B DFlash rollback with the original GDR effective-length ABI and optional Target-only W8A8 dynamic quantization configured by the original inference YAML

package_layout.hiai_source_policy: repository-distributed direct Tensor ABI integration; validated before weight loading and never patched at runtime; export_flag routes CacheUpdate through an AOT-safe functional frontend while ordinary eager keeps the receiver's original mutable op; fused attention routes allQLen SymInt[] through all_seq_lengths_q in both eager and AIR while pse_shift remains absent
package_layout.hiai_output_abi: ordinary Tensor logits; feature-enabled tuple(logits, dflash_features)
package_layout.hiai_bridge_policy: retains the full-prefix oracle and provides persistent rollback with block-aligned real-token prompt chunks on the original GDR route using one INT16[B] call-local effective length, last-real-row LM head, at most 16 unchanged-ABI GDR-MTP verify rows, GDN/conv state banks, provisional paged-KV writes, one logical commit cursor, returned-bank ownership, same-stream ordering without per-call host barriers, and optional Target-only W8A8 conversion plus per-current-block INT8 embedding/FP32 scale dequantization configured by the original inference YAML
package_layout.npu_policy: keep the HIAI target in models/ and install the complete DFlash package in models/dflash_v1/

dflash_reference.algorithm: DFlash V1 draft proposal and strict-greedy Target verification; this package replaces historical-prefix replay with a persistent transactional rollback receiver

target_checkpoint.runtime_policy: exact pinned config preferred; semantic Qwen3.5-4B config variants are accepted and reported, while target weight identity remains external

v1_runtime.draft_cache_contract: request-local six-layer committed K/V; append only new projected Target features, expose the current block transiently, crop on success, abort without mutating committed state, and construct only incremental RoPE positions

npu_embedded_runtime.hiai_runtime_policy: legacy ModelOutput sidecar compatibility only; direct HIAI Tensor/tuple source must not import it
npu_embedded_runtime.target_quant_policy: the CLI mirrors inference.py with --config and --quant_mode enable; the packaged original utils conversion is fail-closed and every pre-conversion nn.Linear path must become the original HIAI QLinear with exact K-by-N shape/device buffers; Draft-facing embedding and LM head remain FP16; every prompt chunk, decode row, and verify block indexes the YAML-declared INT8 embedding and FP32 scale artifacts

rollback_runtime.policy: persistent ordinary and DFlash sessions; prefill restores the original multi-token GDR route with 64-row real-token chunks, INT16[B] call-local effective length, and no padding commit; only the final real prompt row executes the LM head; T=K+1 transactional verification uses the unchanged GDR-MTP ABI; optional Target W8A8 reuses the original QLinear while the Draft stays FP16; fused attention always passes allQLen through the SymInt[] all_seq_lengths_q ABI and leaves optional Tensor pse_shift absent; incremental Draft KV cache; no historical-prefix replay during verify; strict-greedy zero token mismatch

npu_benchmark.policy: strict-greedy gate before timing; original main inference.py and both rollback modes use an equal 32-token budget; quantized ordinary and DFlash use the exact same original YAML and resolved artifacts; rollback ordinary remains the scheduler-control baseline; rollback prefill uses block-aligned real-token chunks on the original GDR route with call-local effective length; separate ordinary/dflash processes; synchronized unprofiled 3+10 baseline; cumulative counters separated from resettable session state; copied-source content identity without VCS metadata; msprof diagnostic only with MSTX disabled by default and explicit opt-in; no CPU fallback
